Privacy Policy

Local first, clearly explained.

Effective September 21, 2026. This policy covers the planned NanaFlow 1.0 release scope.

What we don't collect

NanaFlow requires no account, contains no advertising or third-party analytics SDKs, and does not upload focus history to servers operated by NanaFlow.

Data stored on your device

Timer settings, session history, and display preferences stay on your Mac. If the 1.0 release includes the Widget, the main app and Widget share only the necessary local state through Apple's App Group container.

Notifications

If you allow notifications, NanaFlow uses local macOS notifications to tell you when a focus or break session ends. You can disable them in NanaFlow or System Settings.

Backup and restore

NanaFlow reads or writes a file only after you choose it for export or import. Complete backups use JSON format and remain under your control.

Contact

For privacy questions, contact the maintainers through NanaFlow GitHub Issues. A verified support contact will be added before App Store submission.
